body:
## Problem

The `say-hello` job (pipeline #3) failed at the **Checkout code** step. The CircleCI log shows the SSH clone started but never completed:

```
Cloning git repository - git@github.com:NguyenCuong1989/sturdy-lamp.git
    - Creating a blobless clone for better performance
```

The built-in `checkout` step uses SSH and silently hangs/fails when no deploy key is configured in the CircleCI project settings.

## Fix

Replace the built-in `checkout` step with an explicit `git clone` over HTTPS using CircleCI's built-in env vars (`$CIRCLE_PROJECT_USERNAME`, `$CIRCLE_PROJECT_REPONAME`, `$CIRCLE_SHA1`). HTTPS cloning works for public repositories without requiring an SSH deploy key.

## Note

If this repository is **private**, you will also need to add a GitHub personal access token (or fine-grained token) as a CircleCI environment variable and use it in the clone URL:
```bash
git clone https://$GITHUB_TOKEN@github.com/$CIRCLE_PROJECT_USERNAME/$CIRCLE_PROJECT_REPONAME.git .
```
